body_plan: flame-tailed cat (canon individual is bipedal; species default quadruped)
material: mammalian cat body + a LIVE FLAME at the tail tip (canon: the flame is the tail tip, never a floating orb, never fused into body art)
volume_rule: body near-rigid (mammals do not volume-squash); squash lives in legs/spine only; flame volume is free (it is fire)
rest_shape: canon cutout stance; flame component = cutout x198-271, y81-195, core colour #FD8504

idle.description: chest/flank breathing +/-2% on a 24f loop; tail-base sway; flame flicker cycle ~8f (height +/-25%, tip licks side to side, never symmetrical two frames running); intermittent ear twitch / tail secondary every few loops
idle.secondary_break: ear twitch or tail-tip secondary every 3-5 loops

locomotion.verb: spine gather-extend walk/trot; run = extended stretch poses
locomotion.cycle: spine flexes gather/extend per stride; landing squash in legs/spine only; flame lags and streaks backward, then recovers (follow-through)
locomotion.ground_contact: feet; body pitch follows stride phase

anticipation: pounce crouch-wiggle: hindquarters wiggle 6-8f before a leap; crouch before any jump
settle: leg/spine absorb 4-6f; flame overshoots forward then settles back over 6-8f

secondary_chains.behaviour: own continuous track (see material track) - flicker, lag, state-driven size/rate/colour

signature_motions.name: content curl-up
signature_motions.note: curls, flame dimmed to ember pulse

emotion_map.happy: flame wavers, tail high, ears up
emotion_map.sad: body droops (shoulders/head low), flame low and slow
emotion_map.scared: flame sputters small, body low, ears flat

forbidden_motions: flame symmetrical or identical two frames running
flame drawn as a separate floating orb detached from the tail tip
smear_drawing: leg smear on fastest run beat, 1-2f
sound_linked_motions: cry = chest pulse + flame flare beat

spring.note: flame tip chain: higher frequency than liquid
